## WA


### `/WA/authentication`

_Login to kledo wa, same as singleLogin, filtered & minimum response._


**POST**
  
_Do WA Login_

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `app-client` | header | string | yes | Device Info |
  | `X-Device-Token` | header | string | no | Device Token |

  **Request body** (`application/json`):
  ```json
{
    "email": string
    "password": string
    "remember_me": integer
    "is_otp": integer
  }
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

## api


### `/api/tokopedia/checkStatus`

_Tokopedia PIS - Check Status_


**POST**
  
_Cek status Payment terakhir untuk sebuah ref_id._

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: ref_id, partner_ref_id, client_number, total_amount, response_code, message, timestamp

---

### `/api/tokopedia/health`

_Tokopedia PIS - Health Check_


**POST**
  
_Health check PIS._

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: response_code, message, timestamp

---

### `/api/tokopedia/inquiry`

_Tokopedia PIS - Inquiry_


**POST**
  
_Inquiry tagihan langganan Kledo via client_number._

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: partner_inquiry_id, client_number, total_amount, response_code, message, timestamp

---

### `/api/tokopedia/payment`

_Tokopedia PIS - Payment_


**POST**
  
_Bayar tagihan langganan Kledo (idempoten via ref_id)._

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: ref_id, partner_ref_id, client_number, total_amount, response_code, message, timestamp

---

### `/api/tokopedia/token`

_Tokopedia PIS - Token_


**POST**
  
_Terbitkan token PIS dari client_id + client_secret (envelope ter-enkripsi+signed di mode aman)._

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: response_code, message, token, timestamp

### `/apple-auth/verify`

_Token verification & force login_


**POST**
  
_Token verification & force login_

  ```json
{
    "identity_token": string
    "name": string
    "include_init": integer
    "use_jwt": integer
  }
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: Successful operation
  - `401`: Unauthorized

## dashboard


### `/dashboard/newsUpdate`

_Buat News Update (admin dashboard)_


**POST**
  
_Menyimpan news update baru dari panel admin dashboard (form pada /dashboard/news_update/create). Auth dua jalur (salah satu): (1) API key via header `X-API-Key` — CSRF di-skip; atau (2) sesi login admin + 2FA seperti proses lama (form admin dashboard) — tetap diverifikasi CSRF. Ketika berhasil, flag is_show_news di-set 1 untuk seluruh user dan respons berupa redirect 302 ke halaman index. Alias URL lama `POST /dashboard/news_update` masih didukung untuk kompatibilitas pemanggil existing._

  **Request body** (`multipart/form-data`):
  ```json
{
    "title": string
    "desc": string
    "url": string
    "file": string (binary)
  }
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `302`: Berhasil disimpan — redirect ke /dashboard/news_update dengan flash message success.
  - `400`: Validasi gagal (mis. title/desc kosong atau melebihi batas panjang).
  - `401`: API key tidak valid atau tidak dikirim di header X-API-Key.

### `/finance/contacts/{id}/frequentPurchasedProducts`

_Frequent purchased products for contact_


**GET**
  
_Lists POS products most purchased by this contact. Default aggregation: sales order lines for order-based flows (linked child invoices via business_tran_id are not summed again) plus standalone invoices (no business_tran_id). Query param transaction_scope: omit for default; ordered = only sales orders; purchased = only sales invoices. Excludes void / rejected-draft headers. Optional date_from and date_to on trans_date (Y-m-d). Sorted by total quantity descending._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `id` | path | - | yes | Contact id |
  | `page` | query | integer | no | Page number |
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no | Items per page (max 100) |
  | `search` | query | string | no | Filter product by name, ref_code |
  | `date_from` | query | string | no | Include transactions on or after this date (Y-m-d) |
  | `date_to` | query | string | no | Include transactions on or before this date (Y-m-d) |
  | `transaction_scope` | query | string | no | ordered: only sales order lines. purchased: only sales invoice lines. Omit for default (orders plus standalone invoices, deduplicated). |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

---

### `/finance/deliveries`

_Get a listing of the Finance Delivery._


**GET**
  
_Get all Finance Delivery_

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `search` | query | string | no | Search by memo |
  | `contact_id` | query | string | no | Filter by contact_id |
  | `status_id` | query | string | no | Filter by status_id |
  | `shipping_comp_id` | query | integer | no | Filter by pengiriman expedisi |
  | `shipping_date_from` | query | string | no | Filter by shipping_date, starting date. YYYY-MM-DD |
  | `shipping_date_to` | query | string | no | Filter by shipping_date, ending date. YYYY-MM-DD |
  | `date_from` | query | string | no | Filter by date, starting date. YYYY-MM-DD |
  | `date_to` | query | string | no | Filter by date, ending date. YYYY-MM-DD |
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no | Pagination per page |
  | `sort_by` | query | string | no | Sorting column |
  | `order_by` | query | string | no | Deliverying |
  | `page` | query | integer | no | Which page to render, default 1 |
  | `tags` | query | string | no | contoh: 1,2,3 |
  | `contact_groups` | query | string | no | contoh: 1,2,3 |
  | `show_columns` | query | string | no | ref_number, attachment_exists, memo, warehouse, contact_id, qty, trans_date, termin, tags, status_id, print_status, item_desc, volume, weight, opening_hour, coordinate |
  | `is_recapped` | query | integer | no | Filter apakah pengiriman sudah direkap atau belum. Valid : 1, 0  |
  | `include_weight` | query | integer | no | Param apakah berat di returnkan dalam response. Valid : 1, 0  |
  | `include_volume` | query | integer | no | Param apakah volume di returnkan dalam response. Valid : 1, 0  |
  | `include_coordinate` | query | integer | no | Param apakah coordinate di returnkan dalam response. Valid : 1, 0  |
  | `sales_id` | query | integer | no | sales_id = user_id |
  | `product_id` | query | string | no | contoh: 1,2,3 |
  | `route_id` | query | integer | no | Filter by route id |
  | `fleet_id` | query | integer | no | Filter by fleet id |
  | `terms` | query | string | no | filter untuk term_id contoh: 1,2,3 |
  | `warehouse_id` | query | string | no | warehouse_id |
  | `is_have_attachment` | query | integer | no | filter yang punya attachment, default semua |
  | `include_all_contact_data` | query | integer | no | Include all contact data info |
  | `include_items` | query | integer | no | Include all items data |
  | `include_total` | query | integer | no | Include all recap total |
  | `amount_from` | query | number | no | Filter amount_after_tax >= value (range min). In base currency if multi-currency. |
  | `amount_to` | query | number | no | Filter amount_after_tax <= value (range max). In base currency if multi-currency. |
  | `amount_gt` | query | number | no | Filter amount_after_tax greater than value. In base currency if multi-currency. |
  | `amount_lt` | query | number | no | Filter amount_after_tax less than value. In base currency if multi-currency. |
  | `amount_gte` | query | number | no | Filter amount_after_tax greater than or equal to value. In base currency if multi-currency. |
  | `amount_lte` | query | number | no | Filter amount_after_tax less than or equal to value. In base currency if multi-currency. |
  | `product_category_ids` | query | string | no | untuk filter kategori produk |
  | `country_id` | query | integer | no | Filter berdasarkan negara kontak |
  | `province_id` | query | integer | no | Filter berdasarkan provinsi kontak |
  | `city_id` | query | integer | no | Filter berdasarkan kota/kabupaten kontak |
  | `district_id` | query | integer | no | Filter berdasarkan kecamatan kontak |
  | `village_id` | query | integer | no | Filter berdasarkan kelurahan/desa kontak |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

**POST**
  
_Store Delivery_

  **Request body** (`application/json`):
  ```json
`CreateFinanceDeliveryAPIRequest`
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

### `/finance/materialIssues`

  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |

  | `search` | query | string | no | Cari pada nomor referensi / memo |
  | `status_id` | query | integer | no | 1 = posted, 2 = void, 111 = menunggu persetujuan, 112 = ditolak approver. Kosongkan untuk menampilkan semua (termasuk yang dibatalkan). |
  | `tag_ids` | query | string | no | Daftar tag pada dokumen, dipisah koma (mis. `1,2`). Bentuk array (`tag_ids[]=1`) ikut dilayani. Menjaring dokumen yang menyentuh SALAH SATU tag itu (OR, bukan irisan); dokumen bertag jamak tetap satu baris. |
  | `tag_id` | query | integer | no | DEPRECATED — satu tag saja. Masih dilayani, tapi DIABAIKAN begitu `tag_ids` ikut dikirim (walau kosong), supaya filter yang baru dikosongkan tidak diam-diam jatuh balik ke nilai sisa di query. |
  | `warehouse_id` | query | integer | no |  |
  | `product_id` | query | integer | no | Hanya dokumen yang memuat produk ini pada salah satu itemnya |
  | `date_from` | query | string | no |  |
  | `date_to` | query | string | no |  |
  | `sort_by` | query | string | no |  |
  | `order_by` | query | string | no |  |

  - `200`: successful operation

**POST**
  
_Create Material Issue_

  **Request body** (`application/json`):
  ```json
{
    "trans_date": string (date)
    "warehouse_id": integer
    "account_id": integer
    "contact_id": integer
    "memo": string
    "attachment": array of string
    "items": array of {
      "material_request_item_id": integer
      "product_id": integer
      "qty": number (float)
      "unit_id": integer
      "unit_conv": number (float)
      "tag_ids": array of integer
      "tag_id": integer
      "desc": string
      "serials": array of {
        "product_serial_number_id": integer
        "qty": number (float)
      }
    }
  }
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `404`: Modul Material tidak aktif di perusahaan ini
  - `200`: successful operation
  - `400`: Stok tidak cukup, serial tidak valid, atau baris Material Request tidak issuable

### `/finance/materialRequests`

_List Material Request_


**GET**
  
_List Material Request_

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `page` | query | integer | no |  |
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no |  |
  | `search` | query | string | no | Cari pada nomor referensi / memo |
  | `status_ids` | query | string | no | Daftar status dipisah koma, contoh: 2,3 |
  | `tag_ids` | query | string | no | Daftar tag pada dokumen, dipisah koma (mis. `1,2`). Bentuk array (`tag_ids[]=1`) ikut dilayani. Menjaring dokumen yang menyentuh SALAH SATU tag itu (OR, bukan irisan); dokumen bertag jamak tetap satu baris. |
  | `tag_id` | query | integer | no | DEPRECATED — satu tag saja. Masih dilayani, tapi DIABAIKAN begitu `tag_ids` ikut dikirim (walau kosong), supaya filter yang baru dikosongkan tidak diam-diam jatuh balik ke nilai sisa di query. |
  | `warehouse_id` | query | integer | no |  |
  | `product_id` | query | integer | no | Hanya dokumen yang memuat produk ini pada salah satu itemnya |
  | `date_from` | query | string | no |  |
  | `date_to` | query | string | no |  |
  | `sort_by` | query | string | no |  |
  | `order_by` | query | string | no |  |
  | `issuable` | query | integer | no | Bila 1, hanya permintaan yang masih bisa dikeluarkan materialnya: status issuable (3,4,5) DAN masih ada baris bersisa (qty diminta − qty sudah diklaim, termasuk pengeluaran menunggu persetujuan). Sudah mengurung status sendiri — tak perlu status_ids. Bila digabung status_ids, beririsan; status_ids di luar {3,4,5} akan mengosongkan hasil. |

  **Responses:**
  - `404`: Modul Material tidak aktif di perusahaan ini
  - `200`: successful operation

**POST**
  
_Create Material Request_

  **Request body** (`application/json`):
  ```json
{
    "trans_date": string (date)
    "warehouse_id": integer
    "location": string
    "contact_id": integer
    "memo": string
    "attachment": array of string
    "items": array of {
      "product_id": integer
      "qty": number (float)
      "unit_id": integer
      "unit_conv": number (float)
      "tag_ids": array of integer
      "tag_id": integer
      "desc": string
    }
  }
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `404`: Modul Material tidak aktif di perusahaan ini
  - `200`: successful operation

    "position": integer
    "options": array of {

      "name": string

### `/finance/products`

_Get a listing of the Finance Products._


**GET**
  
_Get all Finance Products_

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `search` | query | string | no | Search by name |
  | `search_column` | query | string | no | target Search by column name |
  | `code` | query | string | no | Get product by Code/SKU |
  | `cat_ids` | query | string | no | Filter by cat_ids. Ex: 1,2,3. Default include all |
  | `include_warehouse_qty` | query | integer | no | Include warehouse qty 0/1, default = 0 |
  | `include_archive` | query | integer | no | Include archive 0/1/2, default = 0 , 2 only archived |
  | `include_deletable` | query | integer | no | Include archive 0/1, default = 0 |
  | `is_sell` | query | integer | no | is sell 0/1, default = 0 |
  | `is_purchase` | query | integer | no | is purchase 0/1, default = 0 |
  | `is_track` | query | integer | no | is track 0/1, default = 0 |
  | `include_stats` | query | integer | no | Include stats 0/1, default = 0 |
  | `include_total` | query | integer | no | Include grand total 0/1, default = 1 |
  | `product_type_id` | query | integer | no | Tipe Produk (0 = Produk Reguler | 1 = Produk Paket | 2 = Produk Manufaktur) |
  | `variant_type_ids` | query | integer | no | Tipe Variant (0 = Tidak ada Variant | 1 = Parent Variant | 2 = Child Variant). Default include all except parent |
  | `variant_only` | query | integer | no | Only show variant products, default 0 |
  | `stock_status` | query | string | no | Stock Status |
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no | Pagination per page |
  | `sort_by` | query | string | no | Sorting column. category_name = sort alfabetis berdasarkan nama kategori primary produk. |
  | `order_by` | query | string | no | Ordering |
  | `show_columns` | query | string | no | contoh valid columns: id,name,photo,code,description,category,base_price,price,qty,hpp,is_track,unit_id |
  | `is_have_attachment` | query | integer | no | filter yang punya attachment, default semua |
  | `sn_type` | query | integer | no | filter untuk menampilkan hanya produk serial. Valid value: -1 (tampilkan semua produk serial unik / produksi), 0 (tampilkan yg bukan produk serial), 1 (tampilkan produk serial unik saja), 2 (tampilkan produk serial kode produksi saja). |
  | `manage_expiry` | query | integer | no | filter untuk menampilkan hanya produk yg mempunyai tanggal kadaluarsa |
  | `have_mp_product` | query | integer | no | filter untuk menampilkan product yang sudah/belum terhubung ke marketplace (mp_products). Jika tenant punya lebih dari satu koneksi marketplace aktif, produk dianggap terhubung hanya jika sudah punya mp_products untuk semua koneksi tersebut (distinct mp_connect_id). Default tidak di filter |
  | `has_modifier` | query | integer | no | filter produk berdasarkan kepemilikan modifier (pos_product_modifier_groups). 1 = hanya produk yang punya modifier, 0 = hanya produk tanpa modifier. Default (tidak dikirim) tidak di filter. Berlaku juga untuk export. |
  | `export_type` | query | string | no | Export mode. compact/expanded. expanded hanya berlaku jika is_serial_number_detail=1. |
  | `print_type` | query | string | no | Print mode (PDF). compact/expanded. expanded hanya berlaku jika is_serial_number_detail=1. |
  | `is_serial_number_detail` | query | integer | no | Khusus mode expanded: 1 untuk menampilkan detail serial number per produk, 0 untuk compact. |
  | `warehouse_id` | query | integer | no | Filter gudang untuk detail nomor seri (mode expanded). Jika di-set (>0), qty & daftar serial mengikuti stok gudang tsb (selaras laporan inventoryProductSerialStockDetail) dan nama file jadi laporan-stok-nomor-seri-gudang-{nama gudang}. |
  | `export_per_page` | query | integer | no | Jumlah serial number per produk per halaman export (hanya untuk expanded). |
  | `export_page` | query | integer | no | Halaman serial number per produk untuk export (hanya untuk expanded). |
  | `print_per_page` | query | integer | no | Jumlah serial number per produk per halaman print/PDF (hanya untuk expanded). |
  | `print_page` | query | integer | no | Halaman serial number per produk untuk print/PDF (hanya untuk expanded). |
  | `with_modifiers` | query | integer | no | 1 = embed full modifier_groups[] (group + options) per produk; default (0/absent) hanya modifier_group_ids[]. |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

**POST**
  
_Store Product_

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `x-module` | header | string | no | app module |

  **Request body** (`application/json`):
  ```json
`FinanceProduct`
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

  | `search` | query | string | no | Filter by name |

  | `contact_id` | query | string | no | Filter by contact id |
  | `sort_by` | query | string | no | Sorting column |
  | `order_by` | query | string | no | Ordering |
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no | Pagination per page |
  | `page` | query | integer | no | Which page to render, default 1 |
  | `is_sell` | query | integer | no | Filter by is_sell |
  | `is_purchase` | query | integer | no | Filter by is_purchase |
  | `is_track` | query | integer | no | Filter by is_track |
  | `trans_date` | query | string | no | get stock on specific date |
  | `default_product_id` | query | integer | no | product_id ini akan selalu dimunculkan di halaman pertama, apapun statusnya |
  | `include_price_rule` | query | integer | no | apakah perlu direturnkan price rule nya? 1/0. Default 0 |
  | `include_stock` | query | integer | no | apakah perlu direturnkan stock nya. Default 1 |
  | `hide_product_empty_stock` | query | integer | no | Override pengaturan bisnis. Bila dikirim, nilai ini dipakai (1=sembunyikan produk stok habis, 0=tampilkan). Bila tidak dikirim, ikut pengaturan bisnis hide_product_empty_stock. |
  | `exclude_product_ids` | query | string | no | Jangan returnkan product dengan id disin. Ex: 1,2,3. Default include all |
  | `hide_serial_product` | query | integer | no | Untuk menyembunyikan produk serial. Valid values = 0 (default), 1. |
  | `warehouse_id` | query | integer | no | Untuk cek sto berdasarkan warehouse id nya |
  | `is_simple` | query | integer | no | 1 hanya returnkan name dan id, 0 returnkan semua field. Default 0 |
  | `variant_type_ids` | query | integer | no | Tipe Variant (0 = Tidak ada Variant | 1 = Parent Variant | 2 = Child Variant). Default include all except parent |
  | `is_favorite` | query | integer | no | return only favorite products |
  | `product_ids` | query | string | no | filter by product ids |
  | `sn_type` | query | integer | no | filter untuk menampilkan hanya produk serial. Valid value: -1 (tampilkan semua produk serial unik / produksi), 0 (tampilkan yg bukan produk serial), 1 (tampilkan produk serial unik saja), 2 (tampilkan produk serial kode produksi saja). |
  | `product_type_id` | query | integer | no | Tipe Produk (0 = Produk Reguler | 1 = Produk Paket | 2 = Produk Manufaktur). Default include all |
  | `currency_id` | query | integer | no | Mata uang transaksi yang sedang dibuka di form. Bila dikirim, produk yang berharga dalam mata uang lain mendapat blok price_converted. Tidak berlaku saat is_simple=1 — payload ringkas itu sengaja tidak dikonversi, dan kolom price di sana tetap bernilai mata uang dasar. |
  | `currency_rate` | query | number | no | Kurs transaksi terhadap mata uang dasar; kirim nilai dari "Ubah nilai kurs" bila user menimpanya. Kosong atau 1 berarti pakai kurs server pada trans_date. Nilai di luar kapasitas kolom kurs transaksi (decimal(12,6)) diabaikan. |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

  | `movement_compare` | query | string | no | optional daterange enum : [daily,monthly,yearly] |
  | `period_compare` | query | integer | no | optional jumlah periode untuk grafik berbasis movement_compare (mis. monthly: 1=satu bulan, 2=dua bulan). Maks 120. |

  | `graph_names` | query | string | yes | nama grafiknya contoh: sales,payment,sales_order,sales_contribution_per_vendor. sales_contribution_per_vendor mengembalikan kontribusi penjualan per vendor (supplier asal produk) dengan field name, amount, percent; produk tanpa riwayat pembelian masuk slice 'Produk Internal'. Khusus sales_contribution_per_vendor, date_from & date_to wajib diisi (omset dihitung per rentang tanggal) |
  | `tag_ids` | query | string | no | contoh: 1,2,3 |
  | `sales_id` | query | integer | no | id of sales person |
  | `outlet_id` | query | integer | no | id of outlet |
  | `pos_shift_id` | query | integer | no | id of pos shift |
  | `additional_param` | query | array | no | additional param |

### `/finance/shopify/callback`

_Shopify OAuth callback_


**GET**
  
_Callback OAuth dari Shopify. Validasi HMAC query dan state ter-enkripsi, tukar code menjadi access_token, simpan koneksi ke tenant, lalu redirect ke URL sukses atau error._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `code` | query | string | yes | Authorization code dari Shopify. |
  | `shop` | query | string | yes | Hostname toko Shopify. |
  | `hmac` | query | string | yes | HMAC signature query string dari Shopify, untuk verifikasi integritas callback. |
  | `state` | query | string | yes | State terenkripsi yang berisi website_id dan metadata lain (wajib untuk multi-tenant). |
  | `timestamp` | query | string | no | Timestamp dari Shopify (opsional). |

  **Responses:**
  - `302`: Redirect ke URL sukses atau error tergantung hasil verifikasi / penyimpanan koneksi.

---

### `/finance/shopify/claimConnection`

_Claim pending Shopify connection_


**POST**
  
_Claim pending Shopify connection (dari App Store install) untuk tenant yang sedang login. Frontend memanggil endpoint ini setelah user login ke Kledo dan meminta claim koneksi pending._

  **Request body** (`application/json`):
  ```json
{
    "shop_domain": string
  }
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: Koneksi berhasil di-claim. Data berisi error_code CLAIM_SUCCESS, title, dan description. Title/description boleh berisi HTML <strong> untuk teks bold (FE bisa render dengan dangerouslySetInnerHTML atau komponen yang render HTML).
  - `400`: Claim gagal. Body info berisi error_code (CLAIM_FAILED, ALREADY_CONNECTED_*, SESSION_EXPIRED), title, description.
  - `403`: User tidak punya permission shopify_connect. Body info berisi error_code ACCESS_DENIED, title, description.

---

### `/finance/shopify/connections`

_List Shopify connections_


**GET**
  
_Daftar koneksi Shopify yang sudah connect untuk tenant (website) saat ini._

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: Daftar koneksi berhasil diambil (connections: array id, website_id, shop_domain, bank_payment_account_id).
  - `400`: Tenant/website tidak valid.

**POST**
  
_Hubungkan toko Shopify via model custom-app (OAuth client credentials grant). Merchant cukup mengirim shop + client_id + client_secret; tidak ada langkah redirect/install. Credential divalidasi secara live (fetch token) sebelum disimpan; client_secret disimpan ter-enkripsi._

  **Request body** (`application/json`):
  ```json
{
    "shop": string
    "client_id": string
    "client_secret": string
  }
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: Toko berhasil terhubung. Data berisi id, shop_domain, scope.
  - `400`: Credential tidak valid (INVALID_CREDENTIALS), shop sudah terhubung, atau tenant tidak valid.
  - `422`: Validasi gagal (shop / client_id / client_secret).

### `/finance/shopify/connections/{id}`

_Get one Shopify connection_


**GET**
  
_Detil satu koneksi Shopify (id, shop_domain, bank_payment_account_id, bank_payment_account). Untuk halaman pengaturan per toko._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `id` | path | integer | yes | Primary key koneksi (shopify_connections.id). |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: Detil koneksi berhasil diambil (connection: id, website_id, shop_domain, bank_payment_account_id, bank_payment_account).
  - `404`: Koneksi tidak ditemukan atau bukan milik tenant.

**PUT**
  
_Update koneksi Shopify (misal bank_payment_account_id) untuk tenant. Hanya koneksi milik website saat ini yang boleh di-update._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `id` | path | integer | yes | Primary key koneksi (shopify_connections.id). |

  **Request body** (`application/json`):
  ```json
{
    "bank_payment_account_id": integer
  }
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: Koneksi berhasil di-update.
  - `404`: Koneksi tidak ditemukan atau bukan milik tenant.

**DELETE**
  
_Hapus koneksi Shopify. Sebelum hapus, semua webhook yang ter-subscribe di toko tersebut di-unsubscribe terlebih dahulu di Shopify._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `id` | path | integer | yes | Primary key koneksi (shopify_connections.id). |

  **Responses:**
  - `204`: Koneksi berhasil dihapus (semua webhook sudah di-unsubscribe).
  - `404`: Koneksi tidak ditemukan atau bukan milik tenant.

### `/finance/shopify/install`

_Install App Store Shopify / embedded app (endpoint App URL)_


**GET**
  
_Endpoint App URL Shopify. Dua perilaku: (1) Jika embedded=1, mengembalikan HTML embedded dengan App Bridge CDN (iframe Admin setelah install). (2) Jika tidak embedded, validasi HMAC lalu redirect ke OAuth authorize Shopify (alur install klasik)._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `shop` | query | string | yes | Hostname toko Shopify, contoh: "mystore.myshopify.com". |
  | `hmac` | query | string | no | Signature HMAC dari Shopify untuk integritas request. |
  | `timestamp` | query | string | no | Timestamp dari Shopify (opsional, anti-replay). |
  | `embedded` | query | string | no | Di-set 1 oleh Shopify Admin saat memuat app di dalam iframe. |
  | `host` | query | string | no | Nilai host base64 untuk App Bridge (dari Shopify Admin). |
  | `id_token` | query | string | no | Session token JWT dari Shopify (saat embedded). |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: HTML embedded dengan App Bridge CDN (jika embedded=1).
  - `302`: Redirect ke OAuth authorize Shopify (jika tidak embedded).

### `/finance/shopify/webhooks/receive`

_Shopify webhook receive endpoint_


**POST**
  
_Menerima webhook POST dari Shopify. Validasi HMAC header, cek idempotency per tenant, lalu dispatch job async untuk memproses event._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256` | header | string | yes | HMAC signature dari Shopify untuk verifikasi integritas payload. |
  | `X-Shopify-Shop-Domain` | header | string | yes | Domain shop Shopify pengirim webhook. |
  | `X-Shopify-Topic` | header | string | yes | Topic webhook (misalnya orders/create, products/update, customers/create, app/uninstalled). |
  | `X-Shopify-Event-Id` | header | string | yes | ID unik event dari Shopify; dipakai untuk idempotency check. |

  **Request body** (`application/json`):
  ```json
object
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: Webhook diterima; jika sudah pernah diproses atau shop tidak terhubung, tetap mengembalikan 200.
  - `400`: Header wajib (topic / shop domain / event id) tidak lengkap.
  - `403`: HMAC tidak valid.
  - `503`: Webhook belum dikonfigurasi (client_secret kosong) atau connection belum di-claim (pending) untuk topic selain app/uninstalled. Shopify akan retry.

### `/finance/zap/customer`

_List Zap customers with optional distance_


**GET**
  
_Lists active customers (finance contacts flagged as customers) with optional distance from the device (kilometers). When latitude/longitude are omitted, distance is null for every row. When the customer has no coordinates, distance is null for that row. today_visit_status is derived from zap_check_ins for the current sales user: among rows with check_in_time on the current calendar day (app timezone), the latest row by check_in_time then id determines the value — checked_in if check_out_time is null, checked_out if set; null when there is no such row._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `page` | query | integer | no | Page number |
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no | Items per page (max 100) |
  | `sort_by` | query | string | no | Sort field; distance requires latitude and longitude |
  | `order_by` | query | string | no | Sort direction |
  | `latitude` | query | number | no | Device latitude; with longitude enables distance |
  | `longitude` | query | number | no | Device longitude; with latitude enables distance |
  | `group_ids` | query | string | no | Filter contact by group ids |
  | `geo_tagged` | query | string | no | 1 = customers with an effective geo point (full finance_contacts lat+lng pair, else first shipping address with both lat+lng); 0 = neither yields a complete pair |
  | `visit_status` | query | string | no | Filter contact visited or not. Valid status : not_visited, on_visit, visited |
  | `search` | query | string | no | Filter by contact name, company, address, or phone (partial match) |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

---

### `/finance/zap/dashboard/products`

_Dashboard zap: produk yang dibawa sales_


**GET**
  
_Produk yang dibawa sales pada canvassing, diagregasi lintas canvassing dan lintas sales. carried_qty = SUM(zap_canvassing_products.initial_qty), sold_qty = SUM(sold_qty), sold_amount = SUM(finance_business_tran_items.amount_after_tax) dari invoice canvassing (invoice void/rejected dikecualikan; saat multi-currency aktif dikali currency_rate item sehingga nilainya dalam base currency). Default urut sold_amount desc. Default hanya canvassing dengan status >= stock_locked (3)._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |

### `/finance/zap/invoice_recap/activeInvoices`

_Get active invoice recap invoices_


**GET**
  
_Invoice lines from the current user's recaps, grouped by contact. Defaults to active recap status (1) and recaps whose period includes today. Optional status (comma-separated recap status: 1=active, 2=completed), invoice_statuses (comma-separated finance invoice status_id), date_from/date_to. Optional filter is_due (due_date vs today, not outstanding balance). Optional filter is_expired (recaps whose period end date is before today)._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `is_due` | query | - | no | If true: due_date not null and due_date <= today. If false: due_date null or due_date > today. Calendar-based, not the due amount column. |
  | `is_expired` | query | - | no | If true (1): only recaps whose period end date (trans_date_to) is before today; overrides the default today-in-period filter. When omitted, no expiry filter is applied. |
  | `date_from` | query | - | no | Filter recaps overlapping this start date (Y-m-d). With date_to, replaces the default today-in-period filter. |
  | `date_to` | query | - | no | Filter recaps overlapping this end date (Y-m-d). With date_from, replaces the default today-in-period filter. |
  | `status` | query | - | no | Comma-separated invoice recap status values: 1=active, 2=completed. Unfiltered when omitted. |
  | `search` | query | - | no | Filter by contact name, company, or invoice ref number (partial match). |
  | `sort_by` | query | - | no | Optional. contact_name (default): A–Z by contact name. distance: nearest contact first using device WGS84 coordinates (requires latitude and longitude). |
  | `order_by` | query | - | no | Sort order direction, possible value : asc, desc |
  | `latitude` | query | - | no | Device latitude (WGS84). Required when sort_by=distance. When both latitude and longitude are sent, each contact group includes distance_km (km to effective contact geo: shipping address if set, else contact). |
  | `longitude` | query | - | no | Device longitude. Required when sort_by=distance. When both latitude and longitude are sent, each contact group includes distance_km (km to effective contact geo). |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

---

### `/marketplaceConnects/tiktok/{connect_id}/products/{product_id}`

_Update TikTok marketplace product_


**PUT**
  
_Update a TikTok listing (full product PUT merged with cached listing on the server). Required JSON: item_name, description, category_id, product_attributes, image_uri_list, skus, delivery_option_ids. Optional: brand_id, package_weight {value, unit}, package_dimension {length, width, height, unit}, is_cod_allowed, minimum_order_quantity, is_pre_owned. Each SKU may include sales_attributes[], sku_weight, sku_dimension, id, seller_sku, price, stock, pre_sale_handling_duration_days (maps to TikTok SKU pre_sale.fulfillment_type.handling_duration_days)._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `connect_id` | path | integer | yes |  |
  | `product_id` | path | integer | yes |  |

  **Request body** (`application/json`):
  ```json
{
    "item_name": string
    "description": string
    "category_id": string
    "brand_id": string
    "package_weight": {
      "value": integer
    }
    "package_dimension": {
      "length": string
      "width": string
      "height": string
    }
    "product_attributes": array of {
      "id": string
      "values": array of {
        "id": string
        "name": string
      }
    }
    "image_uri_list": array of string
    "skus": array of {
      "id": integer
      "seller_sku": string
      "price": number (float)
      "stock": integer
      "pre_sale_handling_duration_days": integer
      "sales_attributes": array of {
        "name": string
        "value_name": string
        "sku_img_uri": string
      }
      "sku_weight": {
        "value": integer
      }
      "sku_dimension": {
        "length": string
        "width": string
        "height": string
      }
    }
    "delivery_option_ids": array of string
    "is_cod_allowed": boolean
    "minimum_order_quantity": integer
    "is_pre_owned": boolean
  }
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

_Clears `last_product_sync_at` on the marketplace connect (system DB) so the next product sync window is not constrained by the previous run, then marks marketplace connects on the tenant as stale for cache invalidation. If the connect id does not exist, the handler returns without updating._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `connect_id` | path | integer | yes | marketplace_connects.id |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: Request completed. Response body may be empty (no JSON envelope); when the connect exists, `last_product_sync_at` is set to null and tenant stale marking runs.

### `/membership/companies/nearby`

_List companies to register into, suggested by nearest outlet_


**GET**
  
_Company picker used during register/login AFTER OTP has been verified (requires the membership Bearer token from verifyOtp) — kept behind auth so company names & outlet locations are not exposed to anonymous callers. Returns registerable companies (have a membership domain + at least one active outlet). Each item includes `endpoint`, the tenant's API host (from hostnames.fqdn) that the client must use as base URL once the company is picked — so there is no need to call /membership/init?domain= just to resolve it; `endpoint` is null when the tenant has no active hostname (such a company cannot be used yet). When latitude & longitude are given, results are limited to companies whose nearest outlet is within radius (default 50 km) and ordered by distance; otherwise ordered by company name. Optional search filters by company name._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `latitude` | query | number | no |  |
  | `longitude` | query | number | no |  |
  | `search` | query | string | no | Filter by company name |
  | `radius` | query | number | no | Max distance in km (only used with latitude & longitude; default 50) |
  | `page` | query | integer | no |  |
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no |  |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: Companies retrieved successfully

---

## personal-access-tokens


### `/personal-access-tokens`

_List all API tokens_


**GET**
  
_Get paginated list of tokens for authenticated user with optional filters_

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no | Number of items per page |
  | `page` | query | integer | no | Page number |
  | `name` | query | string | no | Filter by token name (partial match) |
  | `created_at_from` | query | string | no | Filter by created date from (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss) |
  | `created_at_to` | query | string | no | Filter by created date to (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss) |
  | `expires_at_from` | query | string | no | Filter by expiration date from (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss) |
  | `expires_at_to` | query | string | no | Filter by expiration date to (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss) |
  | `last_used_at_from` | query | string | no | Filter by last used date from (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss) |
  | `last_used_at_to` | query | string | no | Filter by last used date to (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss) |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: Successful operation
  - `401`: Unauthorized

**POST**
  
_Generate a new short personal access token_

{
    "name": string
    "expires_in_days": integer
  }

  - `201`: Token generated successfully
  - `422`: Validation error
  - `401`: Unauthorized

**DELETE**

  - `200`: All tokens revoked successfully
  - `401`: Unauthorized

### `/pos/cashier/reporting/salesSummary`

_Ringkasan penjualan kasir (omzet, transaksi, produk, pembayaran, refund, rincian order/invoice, per outlet, per jam)_


**GET**
  
_Dashboard ringkasan penjualan POS untuk rentang tanggal (date_from..date_to; preset seperti Hari ini/Kemarin/7 Hari ditentukan FE). Semua angka selaras laporan POS (VOID/draft dikecualikan). Menyertakan: omzet total + perbandingan periode setara sebelumnya (persen & arah), total transaksi, total qty produk, terima pembayaran, refund, rincian order/invoice (order belum di-invoice tanpa/ dengan uang muka, invoice belum terbayar/sebagian/lunas), omzet per outlet, dan penjualan per jam (24 bucket). Default semua outlet; isi outlet_id untuk membatasi ke satu outlet. Filter jam opsional: sematkan bagian jam pada date_from/date_to (format Y-m-d H:i), meniru laporan sales detail._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `date_from` | query | string | no | Tanggal awal (Y-m-d) atau tanggal+jam awal (Y-m-d H:i). Default hari ini. |
  | `date_to` | query | string | no | Tanggal akhir (Y-m-d) atau tanggal+jam akhir (Y-m-d H:i). Default hari ini. |
  | `outlet_id` | query | integer | no | Filter opsional ke satu outlet. Kosong = semua outlet. |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

### `/pos/orders/{orderId}/pay`

_Edit order lalu bayar (simpan order + create invoice) dari Kledo POS_


**POST**
  
_Simpan/edit order lalu langsung buat invoice dari order tersebut dalam satu transaksi atomik. SELURUH body top-level adalah payload edit order (divalidasi sama persis dengan PUT /finance/orders/{order}) KECUALI `payments`, `pos_shift_id`, dan `user_id`. Tidak ada pembungkus `order`: items & field order lain berada 1 level dengan `payments`. Konten invoice (items, diskon item, additional discount, fees, delivery fee, memo, invoice type, outlet) DIPROYEKSIKAN dari order tersimpan; nomor invoice di-generate otomatis._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `orderId` | path | integer | yes | Live id order (finance order) yang akan diedit lalu dibayar |

  **Request body** (`application/json`):
  ```json
{
    "items": array of object
    "pos_shift_id": integer
    "user_id": integer
    "payments": array of object
  }
  ```

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

  - `200`: successful operation

### `/pos/reportings/salesPriceRule`

_Get reporting sales by price rule (summary)_


**GET**
  
_POS sales summarized per unique price rule snapshot (id + name/discount/discount_type/markup_type_id). Per row: transaction_count (distinct invoices), item_count (line items with that snapshot), total discount from item discount_amount + additional_discount_amount. Each row includes fingerprint (URL-safe base64 token) for /salesPriceRule/{price_rule_id}/transactions._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `date_from` | query | string | no |  |
  | `date_to` | query | string | no |  |
  | `outlet_id` | query | integer | no |  |
  | `pos_shift_id` | query | integer | no | 0 = no shift filter; >0 = filter by pos_shift_id |
  | `page` | query | integer | no |  |
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no |  |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

---

### `/pos/reportings/salesPriceRule/{price_rule_id}/transactions`

_Get invoice line items for a price rule_


**GET**
  
_Lists finance_business_tran_items for the given price_rule_id with the same filters as the summary. Query fingerprint (required) is the token from the summary row (URL-safe base64)._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `price_rule_id` | path | integer | yes |  |
  | `fingerprint` | query | string | yes | Required; token from summary response (same row as this price_rule_id) |
  | `date_from` | query | string | no |  |
  | `date_to` | query | string | no |  |
  | `outlet_id` | query | integer | no |  |
  | `pos_shift_id` | query | integer | no | 0 = no shift filter; >0 = filter by pos_shift_id |
  | `page` | query | integer | no |  |
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no |  |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

### `/pos/shifts`

_Get data shift (default status closed)_


**GET**
  
_Get data shift (default status closed)_

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `outlet_id` | query | integer | no | outlet id |
  | `user_id` | query | integer | no | filter user/kasir (user_id shift). Kosongkan untuk semua user |
  | `status` | query | string | no | status shift (0=open, 1=closed, all=semua listable). Default (dikosongkan) = closed. Temporary (-1) tidak pernah termasuk |
  | `date_from` | query | string | no | filter tanggal awal (Y-m-d). Default 1 bulan lalu |
  | `date_to` | query | string | no | filter tanggal akhir (Y-m-d). Default hari ini |
  | `date_type` | query | string | no | kolom tanggal yang difilter oleh date_from/date_to (start=waktu mulai, end=waktu selesai). Default start |
  | `export_type` | query | string | no | jika diisi, response berupa file (bukan JSON list) berisi data yang sama sesuai filter. Kosongkan untuk list biasa |
  | `page` | query | integer | no | page |
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no | data per page |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation (JSON list, atau file export jika export_type diisi)

  | `tags` | query | string | no | contoh: 1,2,3 |
  | `tags_setting` | query | string | no | Filter tags setting (all/specific) |
  | `compare` | query | string | no | bandingkan dengan periode sebelumnya, atau dengan tag id |
  | `type` | query | string | no | bulanan, tahunan, atau dengan tag |
  | `custom_compare_date_from` | query | string | no | Compare custom date from. YYYY-MM-DD |
  | `custom_compare_date_to` | query | string | no | Compare custom date to. YYYY-MM-DD |
  | `sort_by` | query | string | no | Sorting column |
  | `order_by` | query | string | no | Ordering |
  | `export` | query | string | no | xls or csv |
  | `include_pdf` | query | integer | no | 1 or 0 |
  | `currency_id` | query | integer | no | Show by currency. |
  | `format_tree` | query | bool | no | 1 or 0, format tree data return jadi berpengaruh pada bentuk data yang dipakai. |
  | `only_parent` | query | bool | no | 1 or 0, apakah akun yang ditampilkan hanya parentnya saja atau dengan anak-anaknya. |
  | `separate_other_revenue_and_expenses` | query | bool | no | 1 or 0, apakah ingin memisahkan kategori pendapatan & biaya lainnya. |
  | `show_columns` | query | string | no | Kolom tambahan laba rugi (option show_columns_reporting_profit_loss), dipisah koma. Contoh: delta, percent_of_parent. delta: kolom delta pada export/PDF. percent_of_parent: tiap baris akun menyertakan persentase terhadap total pendapatan (total.trading_income); untuk akun bertingkat (children), pembagi adalah net akun parent langsung di atasnya. Untuk export=xls/csv dan PDF print, kolom/teks persentase ikut ditampilkan bila percent_of_parent dipilih. |
  | `force_refresh` | query | boolean | no | 1 untuk bypass cache laporan & regenerate (tombol 'Muat ulang' di UI). |
  | `no_cache` | query | boolean | no | Alias dari force_refresh. |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

  | `show_columns` | query | string | no | Kolom opsional: unit, description, product_value, is_archive (status produk Aktif/Diarsipkan). Dipisah koma. |
  | `include_archive` | query | integer | no | Filter produk arsip: 0 = tanpa produk arsip, 1 = semua produk (default), 2 = hanya produk arsip |
  | `warehouse_ids` | query | string | no | Filter by warehouse ids. Ex: 1,2,3. Default include all |
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no | Pagination per page |
  | `sort_by` | query | string | no | Sorting column |
  | `order_by` | query | string | no | Ordering |
  | `page` | query | integer | no | Which page to render, default 1 |
  | `export` | query | string | no | xls / csv |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: successful operation

---

### `/reportings/warehouseStock/massExport`

_Mass export Warehouse Stock reporting._


**GET**
  
_Ekspor massal Laporan Ringkasan Stok Gudang: Excel multi-sheet 1 sheet per gudang induk (xlsx; roll-up butuh >= 2 gudang, per_rack=1 cukup 1 gudang), atau single-sheet pivot (csv / roll-up dengan 1 gudang). Pada per_rack=1, sheet gudang yang punya rak berisi kolom Tanpa Rak + satu kolom per rak + Total; di pivot CSV kolom gudang induk diberi label "<nama gudang> - Tanpa Rak" karena angkanya hanya stok yang tidak dirak. Mengikuti per_page seperti laporan (default 100) — kirim per_page besar untuk seluruh data._

  **Parameters:**
  | Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
  |------|----|------|----------|-------------|
  | `date` | query | string | yes | Summary date |
  | `export` | query | string | no | xls / csv (default xls) |
  | `show_columns` | query | string | no | Kolom opsional: unit, description, product_value, is_archive (status produk Aktif/Diarsipkan) — dipisah koma |
  | `include_archive` | query | integer | no | Filter produk arsip: 0 = tanpa produk arsip, 1 = semua produk (default), 2 = hanya produk arsip |
  | `warehouse_ids` | query | string | no | Filter gudang, contoh: 1,2 |
  | `cat_ids` | query | string | no | Filter kategori produk, contoh: 1,2 |
  | `per_rack` | query | integer | no | 1 = drill-down rak: tiap sheet gudang menampilkan kolom Tanpa Rak + satu kolom per rak + Total. 0 (default) = roll-up, satu kolom Total per gudang (rak dilebur ke induknya). |
  | `per_page` | query | integer | no | Jumlah produk per sheet (default 100). Kirim besar untuk seluruh data. |

  **Responses:**
  - `200`: File Excel/CSV

---
